protocol.output_line: Single valid SK full-binary expression E using S, K, (, ), optional spaces

scoring.raw_metric: L = log2(T(E) + 1) where T(E) is exact normal-order halting steps (0 if invalid/divergent/NL)
scoring.suite_aggregation: mean of per-case norm_score across 512 dynamically generated official cases
scoring.raw_aggregation: mean and max of log2(T(E)+1) plus singularity_count (T >= 2^64 - 1)
scoring.dynamic_generation: 512 distinct OS CSPRNG 64-bit seeds across 8 orthogonal blind-rule/remnant families with live per-case L_ref anchor calibration
scoring.isomorphism_guard: per-case CSPRNG 50% exact S<->K symbol swap
